title: A spawned isolate's `output` field is typed `string`, and not the carrier of the parent's sink.
text: `rule:security/isolate-output-is-captured` and `rule:security/capture-answers-the-carrier` give captured output the parent sink's carrier type: `Core\Html\Markup` under a request and `Cli\Text` everywhere else. The result shape at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/isolate.rs:593` types `output` as `string`, and the module doc at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/isolate.rs:81` still calls the field unsettled. Re-emitting that string escapes the captured bytes a second time. `Core\Cli\Text` alone does not close it, because `echo` escapes a `Cli\Text` under a request (`writes_raw` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/helpers.rs:2776`), and `Core\Out::capture` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/out.rs:151` answers `Cli\Text` under every sink, so it has the same fault. Which static type covers both carriers is the question *What type is captured output under a request?* in `docs/agent/goals/goal-closeout.md`. Closing this builds the answer for both members, checks that a captured page echoes unchanged, and rewrites the module doc's paragraph.
